newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Ex-Im Bank in $100 mln loan deal with CAF.
newsitem.headline: Japan Ex-Im Bank in $100 mln loan deal with CAF.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Japan said on Monday that it would extend and guarantee loans to Venezuela-based Corporacion Andina de Fomento in a credit agreement worth $100 million.
The aim is to promote infrastructure development and trade in the Andean region, the Ex-Im Bank said in a statement.
The Ex-Im Bank said it would provide six billion yen, equivalent to $50 million, and the remaining $50 million would be co-financed by seven commercial banks, led by the Industrial Bank of Japan.
The Ex-Im Bank will also provide a guarantee for the credit extended by the commercial banks.
The Ex-Im bank has provided CAF with four bank-to-bank loans since September 1975, and approved an untied loan totalling 23 billion yen in October 1991, the statement said.
The proceeds of the loan will be used in the Corporacion Andina de Fomento member nations and nations in the Andean region, specifically Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia, it said.
The statement said CAF is a financial institution founded in 1970 to provide financial support for economic development in the Andean region.
